en: 05 STYLE › PRESETS › WORLDS 2026 · SPECIAL: four League of Legends World Championship special presets (CHAMPIONS · BRONZE, STONE, NOIR, LIGHT), each with its own wallpaper and the custom colours, custom case and title tag taken from it, in dark mode with the room in WHITE, backlit; applying one replaces your custom colours and custom case. The backgrounds were generated with Image-2.6-Sunburst and laid out in Photoshop.
A wallpaper can leave the track card's column plain (the special presets do).
zh: 英雄联盟世界赛特别预设：05 外观 › 预设 中新增四套（CHAMPIONS · BRONZE、STONE、NOIR、LIGHT），各带一张壁纸，自定义配色、自定义唱片盒和标签颜色都按壁纸搭配，深色模式，展室为纯白逆光；应用后会替换你的自定义配色和自定义唱片盒。背景由 Image-2.6-Sunburst 生成，Photoshop 排版。
壁纸可以不铺在右侧曲目信息栏下（特别预设即如此）。
